name: Methadone
mechanism: Full μ-opioid agonist; NMDA receptor antagonist properties
dosing: Specialist supervised dosing for OST; analgesic regimens individualised. Risk of accumulation — start low and titrate slowly
contraindications: Respiratory depression, severe asthma, uncontrolled QT prolongation
monitoring: ECG (QT), respiratory status, signs of accumulation
pregnancy: Used in pregnancy for OST under specialist care
sideEffects: Respiratory depression, sedation, QT prolongation, constipation
clinicalPearls: Long half-life and accumulation risk; specialist prescribing and community OST pathways apply
indication: Opioid substitution therapy, severe chronic pain under specialist supervision
